shorts.title: What you will learn: Function templates
shorts.hook: Write one function. Use it with any type.
shorts.script: Write one function. Use it with any type. Today we write code that works for any type. With one template, you replace many copies of the same function. A function template is a recipe. You write it once with a placeholder type, usually called T. When you call it, the compiler writes a real function for the type you used. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: What you will learn: Function templates.

shorts.title: Function templates in one minute
shorts.hook: A function template is a recipe.
shorts.script: A function template is a recipe. You write it once with a placeholder type, usually called T. When you call it, the compiler writes a real function for the type you used. This is called instantiation. Think of a cookie cutter. One shape works with any dough. This line says that T is a placeholder for a type. Keep coding, says Xecxec!

Pear comes after apple, so pear is bigger. The program prints four point five, and then pear. A template is a recipe for functions. Keep coding, says Xecxec!

shorts.title: Bug of the Day: Two different types
shorts.hook: Can you spot the bug in function templates?
shorts.script: Can you spot the bug in function templates? Bug of the Day. We call biggest with an int and a double. The compiler says no matching function for call to biggest with int and double. It must find one T for both. Name the type yourself, in angle brackets. The compiler must find one T for both arguments. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
